user.title: Connect your Pixora display
user.description: Use firmware 2.0.14 or newer. Restart the display, then connect within two minutes. Enter its local IP address. Home Assistant and the display must be on the same subnet. {reason}

reconfigure.title: Reconnect this display
reconfigure.description: Enter this panel’s current IP address. Your existing entity and automations are kept. Firmware 2.0.18 or newer can reconnect without restarting when authorization is still valid; otherwise restart the panel first. {reason}

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address and restart the display to reopen pairing.

abort.invalid_discovery: The app sent invalid display information. Reconnect the display in LED Displays.
abort.panels_registered: Connected displays have been registered automatically.
